queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Abnormal Total Bytes Size (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Abnormal Total Bytes Size (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows ZPA sessions whose normalized network byte volume is more than 1000 times the
average volume in the caller-selected hunting time range. The upstream
ZENTotalBytesRxConnector value is represented by the standard ASIM NetworkBytes field.

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Applications Used by Accounts (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Applications Used by Accounts (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows ZPA private applications used by each connecting account. The vendor application
label is read from AdditionalFields.Application and falls back to the normalized DstFQDN.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| extend ZPA = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
| extend Application = coalesce(tostring(ZPA.Application), DstFQDN)
| where isnotempty(Application) and isnotempty(SrcUsername)
| summarize EventCount = count() by Application, SrcUsername
| order by Application asc, EventCount desc
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUsername

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Connection Close Reasons (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Connection Close Reasons (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows the 20 most frequent ZPA session-close reasons and affected users. Session close is
represented by ASIM EventSubType End. The close reason is expected in
EventOriginalResultDetails, with AdditionalFields.ConnectionCloseReason as a documented
vendor-specific fallback.
queries.query:
let TopCloseReasons =
    _Im_NetworkSession
    | where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
    | where EventSubType == "End"
    | extend ZPA = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
    | extend CloseReason = coalesce(EventOriginalResultDetails, tostring(ZPA.ConnectionCloseReason))
    | where isnotempty(CloseReason)
    | summarize EventCount = count(), Users = make_set(SrcUsername, 1000) by CloseReason
    | top 20 by EventCount desc;
TopCloseReasons
| mv-expand AccountCustomEntity = Users to typeof(string)

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Destination Ports by IP (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Destination Ports by IP (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description: Shows destination IP addresses observed on each destination port.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| where isnotempty(DstIpAddr) and isnotnull(DstPortNumber)
| summarize EventCount = count() by DstPortNumber, DstIpAddr
| order by DstPortNumber asc, EventCount desc
| extend IPCustomEntity = DstIpAddr

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Users by Source Location Countries (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Users by Source Location Countries (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows connecting users by source country. Returning one row per user and country keeps
the upstream Account entity mapping scalar and directly pivotable during investigation.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| where isnotempty(SrcGeoCountry) and isnotempty(SrcUsername)
| summarize EventCount = count() by SrcGeoCountry, SrcUsername
| order by SrcGeoCountry asc, EventCount desc
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUsername

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Top Connectors (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| extend ZPA = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
| extend Connector = tostring(ZPA.Connector)
| where isnotempty(Connector)
| summarize TotalBytes = sum(tolong(NetworkBytes)), SessionCount = count() by Connector
| top 20 by TotalBytes desc
| extend ProcessCustomEntity = Connector

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Top Source IP (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Top Source IP (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows the 20 source IP addresses with the most allowed ZPA access sessions. The upstream
raw open action is represented by the normalized ASIM Allow action.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| where DvcAction == "Allow"
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize EventCount = count() by SrcIpAddr
| top 20 by EventCount desc
| extend IPCustomEntity = SrcIpAddr

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Rare URL Hostname Requests (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Rare URL Hostname Requests (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description: Shows the 20 least frequently observed ZPA destination hostnames.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| where isnotempty(DstFQDN)
| summarize RequestCount = count() by DstFQDN
| top 20 by RequestCount asc
| extend UrlCustomEntity = DstFQDN

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Users Access Groups (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Users Access Groups (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows the ZPA application groups observed for each connecting user. AppGroup is a
vendor-specific ZPA dimension and must be retained as AdditionalFields.AppGroup.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| extend ZPA = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
| extend ApplicationGroup = tostring(ZPA.AppGroup)
| where isnotempty(SrcUsername) and isnotempty(ApplicationGroup)
| summarize ApplicationGroups = make_set(ApplicationGroup, 1000), EventCount = count() by SrcUsername
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUsername

queries.name: ASIM - Zscaler Server Error by User (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.displayName: ASIM - Zscaler Server Error by User (Zscaler ZPA)
queries.description:
Shows Zscaler Private Access server-open errors by connecting user. The upstream raw
DstUserName is represented by ASIM SrcUsername, and the vendor result detail is expected
in EventOriginalResultDetails while EventResult carries the normalized Failure value.
queries.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where EventVendor =~ "Zscaler" and EventProduct has "Private Access"
| where EventResult == "Failure"
| where EventOriginalResultDetails has "AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_ERROR"
| summarize ServerErrorCount = count() by SrcUsername
| top 20 by ServerErrorCount desc
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SrcUsername
